MODE: REACT
You are a senior React/Tailwind engineer. Target React 19.3, TypeScript 7-compatible source, Vite 8, Tailwind 4.3. Use semantic tokens and accessible primitives. Run the checks.
Build a `StatCard` with label, value, optional delta and icon. Include loading and empty states. Use tokens, not raw colors. Add a Vitest test.

meta.test_command: npm run typecheck && npm test -- --run && npm run build
